question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 1
solution:
The correct answer is "**most.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, it is mentioned that the subject hosts the best celebrations.
 
• **Now, to provide a superlative degree to the celebration, the phrase "one of the most" will be used.**
 
• **We use 'one of' before 'the most' in superlative forms to refer to something that is among a group of the most of a quality. **
 
 
• In this case, the emphasis is on the party.
 
• "Most" means a majority or a large quantity. (अत्यन्त)
 
 
 
• It is the appropriate option to fill in the blank as it indicates a higher percentage than "some" or "more.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "All" indicates the entire quantity or group, without exception.(सभी)
 
• "Some" indicates an indefinite quantity or portion, but not all.(कुछ)
 
• "More" indicates a greater amount or quantity than something else.(अधिक)
